taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kenpoly-convocation-arena (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1434 | 2.5 | 2.5
2 | 1879 | 5.42 | 7.92
3 | 318 | 18 | 25.9
4 | 3488 | 24.3 | 50.2
5 | 542 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Reference note: Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station: Kenpoly-convocation-arena (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HKK (recalculated from the layer resistivities 1434→1879→318→3488→542 Ω·m; note this differs from the "A-type" label on file, which should be flagged for re-check)
Aquifer depth: Primary target ≈50.2 m to end of sounding (Layer 5, 542 Ω·m, likely saturated sand); Layer 3 (7.92–25.9 m, 318 Ω·m) is a secondary low-resistivity zone that may represent a shallow clayey aquitard or minor perched aquifer.
Recommendation: Target drilling and screen placement below 50.2 m into the Layer 5 sand unit, while logging carefully through the 7.92–25.9 m interval to confirm whether it is a clay aquitard (avoid screening) or a thin water-bearing sand; re-verify the curve classification against raw field data before finalizing the completion design.
